description: Eye appearance and geometry [REG-03], [DOC-06]: iris [EYE-02], sclera [EYE-03], cornea and tears [EYE-04], eyeball variation [EYE-07] and the editor gaze preview [EYE-06]. Left and right are independent where heterochromia or captured textures need it.

defaults.provisional: The eye shader is not written yet: the value is normalised to 0..1 and the default is a placeholder until the shader and reference renders calibrate it.

parameters.provisional: A dark-brown placeholder: no measured iris colour reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Base colour of the iris, linear Rec.709; set left and right differently for complete heterochromia.

parameters.provisional: A dark-brown placeholder: no measured iris colour reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Colour of the ring around the pupil when central heterochromia is on, linear Rec.709.
Iris colour pattern: none (one colour per iris) or central (a ring of the central colour around the pupil fading into the base colour).
A captured or painted iris texture blob that replaces the procedural iris layers; none uses the procedural iris.
Contrast of the radial fibres of the iris: low values give a smooth iris, high values a strongly striated one.
Amount of crypts, the dark pits between the iris fibres; 0 is none.
Visibility of the collarette, the zig-zag ridge that separates the inner and outer zones of the iris.
Width of the dark ring at the outer edge of the iris; wider rings make the eyes look younger and more defined.
Darkness of the ring at the outer edge of the iris; 0 hides it.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the value scales the template's iris radius as a standardised coefficient (+-3).
parameters.description: Diameter of the iris relative to the eyeball; larger irises show less white.
Depth of the iris behind the cornea (the anterior chamber): deeper irises shift more with the viewing angle through the corneal refraction.
Pupil size between its smallest and largest opening; the iris pattern stretches with it.

parameters.provisional: A neutral off-white placeholder: no measured sclera reference exists in the project yet.
parameters.description: Base colour of the white of the eye, linear Rec.709.
Density of the fine blood vessels on the white of the eye, mostly toward the corners.
Redness of the white of the eye from dilated vessels, as in tired or irritated eyes.
Yellowish discolouration of the white of the eye that comes with age.

parameters.provisional: The default 1.376 is the specification's [EYE-02]; the range around it is not specified.
parameters.description: Index of refraction of the cornea, which bends the view of the iris; a physical constant, locked by default.

parameters.provisional: The default 1.336 is the specification's [EYE-02]; the range around it is not specified.
parameters.description: Index of refraction of the fluid between cornea and iris; a physical constant, locked by default.
How far the clear cornea bulges out of the eyeball in front of the iris; visible in profile and in the catchlights.
Thickness of the tear film and the wet strip along the lower lid margin; higher values give watery, glistening eyes.

parameters.provisional: No reference data yet: the axis is an authored delta of the eyeball meshes and the value its weight (+-3).
parameters.description: Size of both eyeballs; the lids and sockets follow.

parameters.provisional: The template's eye joint limits do not exist yet; the rig clamps the angle to them.
parameters.description: Editor preview of where both eyes look, left (+) or right (-), in degrees; not part of the character.

parameters.provisional: The template's eye joint limits do not exist yet; the rig clamps the angle to them.
parameters.description: Editor preview of where both eyes look, up (+) or down (-), in degrees; not part of the character.
